story_overview: Outside room 1517, Kian and Leo struggle to force open a jammed hotel room door while Marcus watches. After Zara opens it from the inside, Leo changes into a staff uniform to retrieve a suitcase from the room. Meanwhile, other team members, including Alex and Kian, work on technical operations from a command room.

video_prompts:
Leo: Man with dark, meticulously styled hair and a clean-shaven face.
Kian: Young man with slightly disheveled dark hair and an anxious demeanor.
Marcus: Middle-aged man with graying temples.
The 15th Floor Hallway: A long, wood-paneled and carpeted hotel hallway on the 15th floor with the room number '1517' on a wall plaque.
In The 15th Floor Hallway, a flustered Kian pushes against the hotel room door with all his might. Leo joins him, and together they put their shoulders into forcing the door open. Marcus, wearing the black suit jacket, stands behind them, watching anxiously.

Zara: Woman with short, dark bobbed hair and a discerning expression.

In The 15th Floor Hallway, Zara, wearing the patterned blouse, opens the hotel room door as Kian watches anxiously beside her.
